title: Arakhin 25
description: Months are not counted against the Temple but may be counted in its favor, a new mishna sets the ancestral field at fifty shekels for the sowing of a ḥomer of barley, and the Gemara asks who preserves a redeemed field for its owner at the Jubilee and what happens to a field no one redeems.
topics: 🗓️ “After the Jubilee”: any year in the cycle, and months are not deducted from the price
➕ The priest may “reckon for him” months as a full year, in the Temple’s favor
🌾 Fifty shekels for the sowing of a kor of barley: seed, not crop; by hand, not by oxen; neither dense nor sparse
🪨 Crevices and boulders ten handbreadths: Mar Ukva bar Ḥama’s crevices full of water
💰 A sela and a pundeyon a year, all at once, and the owner’s added fifth
👨‍👦 Son, brother, daughter, husband: who preserves the field for its owner at the Jubilee
🏛️ A priest who redeemed the field may not keep it: “his ancestral possession” and not this one
⚖️ An unredeemed field at the Jubilee: Rabbi Yehuda, Rabbi Shimon and Rabbi Eliezer’s “abandoned field”
